summary:
**Worked:** two videos a day roughly doubled daily views on YouTube (953 to 1,964), TikTok (422 to 938), and Instagram (129 to 252) with views per video near flat; the 7 p.m. videos score the same as noon (median 1.06 against 1.04); Moscow's second cut (1.65), Operation Queen (1.54, a 73 percent TikTok hold), and Metz (1.42, Instagram's best Reel at 235) led.

**Didn't:** courtroom and conference videos opening on people standing (Jackson 0.73, Nuremberg 0.91); Facebook fell on both counts (1 to 0 views per post, 168 to 40 a day).

**Patterns:** Living Cards beat Story Cards; openings on combat or firing beat other motion.

**Cards:** no card after 15 Nov can be scored, because the old Threads profile's readings were lost in the restart; card scores return once the new profile has 5 cards past 48 hours (likely 1 Dec).

**Tests:** C still has no Story Card; D (no hashtags on X) running, reviewed 8 Dec. No new test proposed.

**Decisions:** none. Name This still went to Instagram on 18 and 21 Nov after your call to end it.
